title: Integrating Analysis Views in Business Central Extensions
summary: Business Central AL 17.0 Runtime adds the ability to package and deploy Analysis Views in extensions. You can export Analysis View definitions as JSON files, include them in page or page extension AL code, and deploy them to automatically add pre-built analysis views to list pages in any Business Central environment.
key_points: Export analysis views from the UI as JSON definition files using the Export Definition option
Include JSON files in your AL extension project and reference them in page or page extension code using the analysisviews section
For page extensions, use addlast or addfirst anchors to position views; for new pages, no anchor is needed
Packaged analysis views are read-only with a lock indicator, but users can duplicate and edit copies
This feature ships in Wave 1 2026 and works with standard pages and custom pages alike

quotes.text: The Business Central AL 17.0 Runtime adds a feature that allows for the packaging and deployment of Analysis Views.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the new capability being introduced and the version where it becomes available
